Both on a professional and amateur basis, I find myself thinking.
Unfortunately, only thinking does not produce a thought worth having, sharing, or standing behind.
Thankfully, the process of writing (or speaking) is soul-wringing enough to refine partial ideas into something more.
Thus, someone who thinks needs a journal.
This is my journal of Half-baked, Unverified, Notions, Conjectures & Hypotheses (HUNCH).

I won't ever share these on social media, and I'd ask that you think very carefully before deciding whether that's a good idea.
Many of these are terrible ideas, or bad takes, and almost certainly don't reflect what I think at this given moment because I have likely grown since.
But, they're my way of forcing myself to understand.
I post them online so that the terror of someone actually reading them forces me to be clean (or, try to).

---
